brief_references.role: Glossy rounded foam, microbubble highlights and clean cartoon shading.
Baseline for the original uniform ring. Consulted visually for comparison.

attempts.prompt:
Create frame 1 of a high-end mobile bubble-puzzle game FX sprite. Reference image is an existing bubble pop sequence; translate its friendly polished, pearl-white foam and round glossy bubble highlights into ONE single large circular outward air-pressure wave, face-on, centered, no perspective. Do not reproduce the strip or its solid bubble. Square canvas, actual transparent PNG, wide clear margins. On a 1024x1024 canvas the front's outer diameter is 920px, center (512,512); the hollow central disc, radius at least 320px, is completely empty and transparent.
This is the instant after detonation, the strongest and thickest frame. Convey air being shoved radially outward: sculpt a broad, luminous, slightly undulating pearly-white shock lip with some compressed overlapping curved pressure folds and broken slender echo arcs immediately INSIDE that lip, then a short soft mist falloff into clear air. Different local thicknesses around the circumference; the interior of the annulus has transparent windows between layers. One tight round pressure front. White hot glints on selected outward-facing edges. Scatter fine round soap-foam microbeads in little asymmetric groups riding the lip, mixed tiny microbubbles and a few small glossy hemispheres, highlights at upper left like the third and fourth reference cels, never large balls or a necklace. Mostly neutral milky WHITE, restrained hints of pale lilac, cyan, blush and lemon opalescence on a few slivers only. Keep the bead sizes subordinate to the sculpted wave. Make the outward punch, layered refraction, directional folds and foam readable at small game size. Clean rounded, economical cartoon 2.5D VFX, not photoreal, no huge water splashes, no curling ocean surf. No broad disc, globe, filled center, draped white smoke, stars, sunburst, radial spokes, rainbow band, fireworks, flame, text, HUD, border or background. Preserve real transparency BOTH inside and outside the ring. Just one annular sprite.

Transparent 2D animation sprite edit, one square cel in a mobile bubble puzzle game effect. Input 1 is the strong initial shockwave art, the source cel to advance. Input 2 is a material/highlight guide from the game only. Produce a single square 1024x1024 frame with the original 90%-canvas outer diameter centered; the game will scale the cel during animation. Keep margins for all details, no perspective, real transparent RGBA inside and outside. W2, the spreading wave. Advance the attached W1 cel one step in time, preserving the EXACT same center and outer ring diameter. Most of the voluminous soft body of the thick annulus has already thinned. Depict the same outward moving pressure front as a much slimmer translucent membrane, about half of W1's band width and luminous mass. A clear narrow clean white leading edge on the OUTSIDE, plus small portions of a secondary and tertiary broken ripple on its INSIDE. Let these delicate inner contours locally bend and pinch like air refracting, curving concentrically. Vary the width and curvature slightly around the ring; avoid a uniform geometric outline or interlocked wreath. Erase big pillowy curls. There are far fewer very small foam beads, drifting from the same clusters as W1. A tiny pearl-cyan/lilac sheen only in isolated glints. The center must be optically empty, truly alpha zero, the artwork confined to the outer annulus. Drop any cloudy or colored fill, use alpha to express translucency. No field, cel sheet, central object, text, star, sun flare, cartoon impact spokes, opaque background or radiating burst.

Create a transparent game VFX animation in-between. Input 1 is the previous spreading cel W2, input 2 its initial W1 burst, input 3 the game's foam-highlight reference. EDIT W2 into the next cel: W3 thinning and starting to fragment. Preserve W2's exact axis, face-on view, outer diameter (about 90% of this 1024-square frame), original undulating circumference and consistent pearl-white material/upper-left lighting. Only the decay phase changes. Lose almost all the broad translucent membrane. Keep a thread-thin pearly-white wave front around about 65–75% of that circumference, opening distinct gaps especially at 1–2 and 6–7 o'clock. The narrow remaining arcs have tapered ends, soft white specular pinstripes and a whisper of opalescence. A couple of much fainter shorter inner echoes. Where the rim breaks, about 12 irregular little groups of separated round white foam bubbles and pinhead droplets are pulling free, in the same spatial neighborhood as the original ring; a few are glossy with one tiny rounded highlight. Vary their grouping and spacing, no uniform necklace. Small legible, clean, charming bubble particles, do not make snow dust, glitter or stars. Overall slimmer, less bright and less substantial than the W2 input, still readable as a coherent outward wave immediately before it vanishes. No foggy disc or central object, all space inward of the narrow rim is actual zero alpha. Keep the entire effect inside the canvas, blank margin all around. No text, canvas background, explosion rays, HUD or contact sheet. One isolated square RGBA cel.

Transparent 2D animation sprite edit, one square cel in a mobile bubble puzzle game effect. Input 1 is the strong initial shockwave art, the source cel to advance. Input 2 is a material/highlight guide from the game only. Produce a single square 1024x1024 frame with the original 90%-canvas outer diameter centered; the game will scale the cel during animation. Keep margins for all details, no perspective, real transparent RGBA inside and outside. W4, the very last dissipating animation cel. Preserve the exact center and radius implied by the attached W1 frame but ERASE about 95% of the physical ring. That formerly thick annulus has now entirely burst apart. Place only 9–13 small irregular, widely separated wispy groups around the original circular locus, with several large sectors completely empty. Just 2–4 tiny diminishing pearl-white foam droplets per group (roughly 2–9 pixels wide on a 1024 canvas), some groups only a single bead, a few microspecks. Keep the subtle rounded bead highlights of the input at this much smaller scale. Two or three DELICATE almost invisible narrow crescent wisps left behind at the former front, each much less than one eighth of the circumference, tapering fully to transparent at both ends. The sparse distribution of fragments alone suggests the former ring. No closed line, no outline connecting the groups, no complete circle of mist, no secondary inner ring. Mostly empty alpha, quiet, low energy, literally the last breath of the same soap bubble shock. White almost entirely, only an occasional pale icy glint. Make the center and all spaces between groups COMPLETELY transparent. Need the little clusters to be legible but suitably sparse for this last frame. No field, cel sheet, central object, text, star, sun flare, cartoon impact spokes, opaque background or radiating burst.

export.alignment: Source annular outer contours fitted by angular sector with an axis-aligned aspect correction and centered at (512,512). Outer radius target 460.8 px.
export.matting: Neutral dark shading converted to alpha for arbitrary board colors, pale hue preserved and saturation limited. Coverage resampled in premultiplied color, low alpha noise removed, zero RGBA outside the effect.
